visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Loop Instead of Two
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Every start and end position is tried with a nested loop, adding the numbers one by one. Use Kadane's single loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The nested loops try about n squared / 2 ranges. Kadane's algorithm remembers the best sum ending at the current element, so one pass of n steps is enough.
